name: Peninnah
bio: Peninnah was Elkanah's other wife, who had children and repeatedly provoked the childless Hannah, bringing her to tears and causing her to go without eating (1 Samuel 1:2-7). Scripture records little else about Peninnah herself; her role mainly serves as the source of Hannah's suffering, which in turn highlights all the more clearly the LORD's genuine grace in finally answering Hannah's prayer with the gift of Samuel (1 Samuel 1:1-20).
